strengths.description: Solution Architect for the Digital Certificate Solution, establishing CAP services as central orchestration engines and defining API-first integration strategies across Novo Nordisk ERP systems. I build quality, compliance, audit readiness, and validation-proof documentation into the architecture.

Hands-on SAP BTP administration across sub-accounts, user roles, Cloud Connector configuration, and security hardening. Full-stack CAP and UI5 implementation supports pragmatic architecture built on RESTful services, OData, and secure system-to-system integrations.

Designing and demonstrating Model Context Protocol capabilities that expose SAP BTP and CAP APIs as tools for AI agents. I explore agent loops, tool-based reasoning, and AI-assisted development while helping teams adopt responsible prompt engineering and agent governance.

Governing CI/CD pipelines, release management, vulnerability remediation, log reviews, troubleshooting, and production readiness across TEST and PROD environments. I mentor developers on CAP, OData, UI5, and testing while contributing to SAP BTP architecture discussions.
